name: qBittorrent Enhanced Edition
description: 基于官方开源 qBittorrent 增强的 BT/PT 神器，自动拦截迅雷、QQ旋风等吸血客户端，支持自动更新 Tracker 列表加速下载。
descriptionEn: Community-enhanced fork of qBittorrent. Automatically blocks leeching clients (Xunlei/QQ) and auto-updates public BitTorrent trackers.
warningText: 完全开源免费。下载公网 BT 资源建议在设置中开启自动更新公共 Tracker 列表以获得高速连接。
warningTextEn: Free and open-source. For public torrents, enable automatic tracker updating in settings to maximize swarm connectivity.

name: Motrix
description: 极具现代美感的全能下载工具，支持 HTTP、FTP、BT 磁力链接，搭配浏览器插件可接管网页全量下载。
descriptionEn: A full-featured, visually modern open-source download manager powered by Aria2. Handles HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, and magnet links seamlessly.
warningText: 纯开源无套路。若遇到个别 BT 下载速度慢，可前往官网说明手动更新 Tracker 服务器列表。
warningTextEn: No hidden paywalls or telemetry. If torrent speeds lag, update the built-in custom tracker server list from preferences.

name: Spotube
description: 开源无广告跨平台 Spotify 客户端，利用 Spotify 数据接口 + YouTube/Piped 音频源，免开会员享受高品质音乐与歌词滚动。
descriptionEn: Open-source, ad-free Spotify client combining Spotify metadata with YouTube/Piped audio streams without requiring Spotify Premium.
warningText: 不依赖 Spotify Premium 会员。需要一个免费的 Spotify 账号用以同步歌单，音源通过流媒体公开节点获取。
warningTextEn: Zero Premium subscription required. Syncs user playlists via a free Spotify account and streams audio from decentralized public endpoints.

name: MusicFree
description: 插件化开源音乐播放器（Android + Windows），本体只做播放容器，通过社区插件即可实现全网音乐聚合搜索与无损试听。
descriptionEn: Plugin-based open-source music player for Android & Windows. Pure playback shell that integrates community scrapers for decentralized streaming.
warningText: 软件本体没有任何侵权音频，纯净无广告。音源全靠安装社区爱好者分享的插件包，请在 GitHub Issues 寻找官方插件仓库。
warningTextEn: Core app contains zero copyrighted media. Audio streaming depends entirely on community-maintained plugin scripts from GitHub.

name: FreeTube
description: 为电脑端打造的开源 YouTube 纯净客户端。所有订阅、历史记录均保存在本地磁盘，无需 Google 账号，彻底免除一切视频贴片广告。
descriptionEn: The private open-source YouTube desktop player. Watch ad-free videos and subscribe to channels locally without requiring a Google account.
warningText: 无任何内购与广告。若遇到视频加载缓慢，可在设置中切换内置的 Invidious API 镜像节点。
warningTextEn: Ad-free with zero telemetry. If streaming hangs, switch between built-in Invidious or Piped backend mirrors in settings.

name: LosslessCut
description: 基于 FFmpeg 的瑞士军刀级音视频极速无损剪辑神器。无需重新编码渲染，秒级提取视频高光片段与伴音，画质无任何损失。
descriptionEn: The Swiss Army knife of lossless video and audio trimming powered by FFmpeg. Cuts and stitches clips in seconds without re-encoding.
warningText: 在 GitHub Releases 完全免费下载；微软商店版为作者的自愿赞助通道，两者功能完全一致。
warningTextEn: 100% free via GitHub Releases. The Microsoft Store listing is an optional donation avenue with identical features.

name: PotPlayer (纯净设置版)
description: Windows 平台最强万能硬件加速媒体播放器，支持 HDR 映射、插帧补帧与外挂字幕实时翻译。
descriptionEn: High-performance Windows multimedia player with comprehensive hardware decoding, smooth playback, and madVR compatibility.
warningText: 避坑提示：官方安装包有轻量推送倾向，安装时务必取消勾选所有附加推广软件，并在防火墙中拦截其联网联网权限即可永绝弹窗！
warningTextEn: Adware Heads-up: Official installers bundle optional third-party toolbars. Uncheck all sponsor offers during setup or block outbound firewall access.
